name: 33983 · Punta Gorda, FL
findings: ZIP 33983 (Punta Gorda) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33983 (Punta Gorda) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33983 (Punta Gorda) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).
